comments.body:
Are you in D-CHAB's Biochemistry - Chemical Biology programme or D-BIOL's Biochemistry master?

Students of the former belong to VCS: https://vcs.ethz.ch

Students of the latter belong to VeBiS: https://vebis.ch

When enrolling for the semester, there's a box you can check to become a member of VSETH (I think it's checked by default). If you do that, you automatically become a member of your programme-specific association.
comments.author: Nurnstatist
